Internal iterators for all funk records and transactions.

# Purpose
`fd_funk_private.h` defines internal iterator helpers for the `funk` data structures and is not intended for public use. It includes iterator types and small inline functions for walking all record objects in `fd_funk_rec_map_t` and all transaction objects in `fd_funk_txn_map_t`, while skipping empty hash chains. The file also documents the expected usage pattern for each iterator and states that no concurrent write access may occur during iteration. One comment notes a future change for transaction traversal, where a depth-first search of the transaction tree should replace the current approach.
